messages:
acme_cto: Hey @support-team — trying to apply promo code REDWOOD50 in our org (org_9876) and getting "Promo code invalid/expired" both in the Console and via the API. Account email: sarah@acme.com. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/abc123

Sam Support: Sorry you're hitting that. Can you confirm the exact code and where you got it from (email/link)? Also which region/plan you tried on? I'll pull redemption logs for org_9876.

acme_cto: It's exactly REDWOOD50 (caps). We got it in a marketing email last Thurs. Region: us-west. New org, no previous accounts.

Sam Support: Thanks. Quick ask: can you paste the raw API response you get? Also trying a UI screenshot is helpful.

acme_cto: API response (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/promos/redeem -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." -d '{"promo":"REDWOOD50","org_id":"org_9876"}'

# response 400
{"error":"promo_not_found","message":"Promo code invalid or expired"}
```

Sam Support: I pulled backend logs for REDWOOD50: I see a failed redemption attempt at 2024-12-02T14:03:12Z with error code `code_not_found`. I also see an earlier creation event. @Jordan (Billing) can you confirm the promo metadata?

Jordan (Billing): jumping in — that code pattern looks like an internal single-use test code. Maya, do you have more visibility on creation/expiry flags?

maya_eng: I checked the promo service: REDWOOD50 was created 2024-11-29 with metadata: `single_use=true`, `expires_at=2024-12-01T23:59:59Z`. It looks like it was never intended for public marketing; probably a mis-tag in the campaign export. We're investigating leak path. We can manually grant equivalent credits to org_9876 while we sort this out.

Sam Support: Understood. @acme_cto — we can either: 1) manually apply a $200 trial credit to sarah@acme.com right now, or 2) issue a fresh promo code (multi-use) that expires later. Which do you prefer?

acme_cto: Manual credit preferred so we can continue testing today. How long will that take?

maya_eng: I'll issue the manual grant now. Creating billing operation -> `grant_8345`. ETA ~10-15 minutes to propagate to Console. We'll also blacklist any similar test codes.

billing-bot: Promo grant completed: grant_8345 -> applied $200 credit to account sarah@acme.com (org_9876). Operation time: 2024-12-02T14:21:05Z.

Sam Support: Done on our side — you should see $200 in Console > Billing > Credits. Try the API call again (no promo param needed) to confirm charges are applied. If you'd rather a redeemable code, we can create `REDWOODTRIAL2025` (multi-use, expires 2025-06-30).

acme_cto: Confirmed — balance visible and a test generation call works now. Thanks for the fast help :tada:

Sam Support: Really sorry for the confusion and the unintended code. We'll follow up with a short postmortem on how this slipped into the campaign export. Closing this thread after follow-up notes. If anything else pops up, ping me directly. :raised_hands:
